digest.component_or_area: event store writer / ticket directory creation
propositions: Writer crashes between ticket directory creation and first event file write leave orphaned empty directories that fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH, reproducing the illsuited-erect-ibis production signature.
Single-event and batch ticket creation paths both call _prepare_event which runs os.makedirs outside the write lock, creating a vulnerable window where interruption strands an empty ticket directory.
Staging directory and first event must be published atomically under the write lock using os.rename to ensure an event file is never visible before rebase guard and under_lock_check pass.
Temporary staging paths use dot-prefix convention (.tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex>) to remain invisible to existing fsck scanners without requiring scanner changes.

Stale staging directories from dead writers must be swept at creation start using process ownership verification (host + pid-namespace + start-time stamp) to prevent accumulation without violating bug 043f constraints.

AC4-converted sites (batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT) must apply the same atomic staging pattern; exempted sites are architecturally unable to leave fsck-visible directories under the tracker root.
